lines.gurmukhi: ਕੋਈ ਐਸੋ ਰੇ ਭੇਟੈ ਸੰਤੁ ਮੇਰੀ ਲਾਹੈ ਸਗਲ ਚਿੰਤ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਸਿਉ ਮੇਰਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: koee aiso re bhetai sa(n)t meree laahai sagal chi(n)t thaakur siu meraa ra(n)g laavai ||2||
lines.translation: Is there any such Saint, who would meet with me, take away my anxiety, and lead me to enshrine love for my Lord and Master. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੜੇ ਰੇ ਸਗਲ ਬੇਦ ਨਹ ਚੂਕੈ ਮਨ ਭੇਦ ਇਕੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਨ ਧੀਰਹਿ ਮੇਰੇ ਘਰ ਕੇ ਪੰਚਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: paRe re sagal bed nah chookai man bhed ik khin na dheerahi mere ghar ke pa(n)chaa ||
lines.translation: I have read all the Vedas, and yet the sense of separation in my mind still has not been removed; the five thieves of my house are not quieted, even for an instant.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੋਈ ਐਸੋ ਰੇ ਭਗਤੁ ਜੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਤੇ ਰਹਤੁ ਇਕੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੇਰੈ ਰਿਦੈ ਸਿੰਚਾ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: koee aiso re bhagat j maaiaa te rahat ik a(n)mrit naam merai ridai si(n)chaa ||3||
lines.translation: Is there any devotee, who is unattached to Maya, who may irrigate my mind with the Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the One Lord? ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੇਤੇ ਰੇ ਤੀਰਥ ਨਾਏ ਅਹੰਬੁਧਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਲਾਏ ਘਰ ਕੋ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਇਕੁ ਤਿਲੁ ਨ ਮਾਨੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jete re teerath naae aha(n)budh mail laae ghar ko thaakur ik til na maanai ||
lines.translation: In spite of the many places of pilgrimage for people to bathe in, their minds are still stained by their stubborn ego; the Lord Master is not pleased by this at all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਦਿ ਪਾਵਉ ਸਾਧਸੰਗੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਆਨੰਦੁ ਗਿਆਨ ਅੰਜਨਿ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਇਸਨਾਨੈ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: kad paavau saadhasa(n)g har har sadaa aana(n)d giaan a(n)jan meraa man isanaanai ||4||
lines.translation: When will I find the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy? There, I shall be always in the ecstasy of the Lord, Har, Har, and my mind shall take its cleansing bath in the healing ointment of spiritual wisdom. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਅਸ੍ਰਮ ਕੀਨੇ ਮਨੂਆ ਨਹ ਪਤੀਨੇ ਬਿਬੇਕਹੀਨ ਦੇਹੀ ਧੋਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: sagal asram keene manooaa nah pateene bibekaheen dehee dhoe ||
lines.translation: I have followed the four stages of life, but my mind is not satisfied; I wash my body, but it is totally lacking in understanding.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੋਈ ਪਾਈਐ ਰੇ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਮਲੁ ਖੋਏ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: koee paaeeai re purakh bidhaataa paarabraham kai ra(n)g raataa mere man kee duramat mal khoe ||5||
lines.translation: If only I could meet some devotee of the Supreme Lord God, imbued with the Lord's Love, who could eradicate the filthy evil-mindedness from my mind. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਮ ਧਰਮ ਜੁਗਤਾ ਨਿਮਖ ਨ ਹੇਤੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਗਰਬਿ ਗਰਬਿ ਪੜੈ ਕਹੀ ਨ ਲੇਖੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: karam dharam jugataa nimakh na het karataa garab garab paRai kahee na lekhai ||
lines.translation: One who is attached to religious rituals, does not love the Lord, even for an instant; he is filled with pride, and he is of no account.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਭੇਟੀਐ ਸਫਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਕਰੈ ਸਦਾ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਕੋਊ ਨੇਤ੍ਰਹੁ ਪੇਖੈ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: jis bheteeai saphal moorat karai sadaa keerat gur parasaad kooo netrahu pekhai ||6||
lines.translation: One who meets with the rewarding personality of the Guru, continually sings the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises. By Guru's Grace, such a rare one beholds the Lord with his eyes. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਹਠਿ ਜੋ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਤਿਲੁ ਨ ਲੇਖੈ ਪਾਵੈ ਬਗੁਲ ਜਿਉ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਲਾਵੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਰੇ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: manahath jo kamaavai til na lekhai paavai bagul jiu dhiaan laavai maaiaa re dhaaree ||
lines.translation: One who acts through stubbornness is of no account at all; like a crane, he pretends to meditate, but he is still stuck in Maya.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੋਈ ਐਸੋ ਰੇ ਸੁਖਹ ਦਾਈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਕਥਾ ਸੁਨਾਈ ਤਿਸੁ ਭੇਟੇ ਗਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਹਮਾਰੀ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: koee aiso re sukhah daaee prabh kee kathaa sunaaee tis bhete gat hoi hamaaree ||7||
lines.translation: Is there any such Giver of peace, who can recite to me the sermon of God? Meeting him, I would be emancipated. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਪ੍ਰਸੰਨ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਰਾਇ ਕਾਟੈ ਰੇ ਬੰਧਨ ਮਾਇ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: suprasa(n)n gopaal raai kaatai re ba(n)dhan maai gur kai sabad meraa man raataa ||
lines.translation: When the Lord, my King, is totally pleased with me, He will break the bonds of Maya for me; my mind is imbued with the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਆਨੰਦੁ ਭੇਟਿਓ ਨਿਰਭੈ ਗੋਬਿੰਦੁ ਸੁਖ ਨਾਨਕ ਲਾਧੇ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਨ ਪਰਾਤਾ ॥੮॥
lines.transliteration: sadaa sadaa aana(n)d bhetio nirabhai gobi(n)d sukh naanak laadhe har charan paraataa ||8||
lines.translation: I am in ecstasy, forever and ever, meeting the Fearless Lord, the Lord of the Universe. Falling at the Lord's Feet, Nanak has found peace. ||8||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਫਲ ਸਫਲ ਭਈ ਸਫਲ ਜਾਤ੍ਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: saphal saphal bhaee saphal jaatraa ||
lines.translation: My Yatra, my life pilgrimage, has become fruitful, fruitful, fruitful.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣ ਰਹੇ ਮਿਲੇ ਸਾਧਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ ॥੧॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: aavan jaan rahe mile saadhaa ||1|| rahaau doojaa ||1||3||
lines.translation: My comings and goings have ended, since I met the Holy Saint. ||1||Second Pause||1||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਛੰਤ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 1 chha(n)t ||
lines.translation: Dhanaasaree, First Mehl, Chhant:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੀਰਥਿ ਨਾਵਣ ਜਾਉ ਤੀਰਥੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: teerath naavan jaau teerath naam hai ||
lines.translation: Why should I bathe at sacred shrines of pilgrimage? The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is the sacred shrine of pilgrimage.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੀਰਥੁ ਸਬਦ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਹੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: teerath sabad beechaar a(n)tar giaan hai ||
lines.translation: My sacred shrine of pilgrimage is spiritual wisdom within, and contemplation on the Word of the Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਥਾਨੁ ਤੀਰਥੁ ਦਸ ਪੁਰਬ ਸਦਾ ਦਸਾਹਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur giaan saachaa thaan teerath das purab sadaa dasaaharaa ||
lines.translation: The spiritual wisdom given by the Guru is the True sacred shrine of pilgrimage, where the ten festivals are always observed.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਸਦਾ ਜਾਚਉ ਦੇਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਧਰਣੀਧਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: hau naam har kaa sadaa jaachau dehu prabh dharaneedharaa ||
lines.translation: I constantly beg for the Name of the Lord; grant it to me, O God, Sustainer of the world.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਰੋਗੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਦਾਰੂ ਮੈਲੁ ਲਾਗੈ ਸਚ ਬਿਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)saar rogee naam daaroo mail laagai sach binaa ||
lines.translation: The world is sick, and the Naam is the medicine to cure it; without the True Lord, filth sticks to it.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਵਾਕੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਸਦਾ ਚਾਨਣੁ ਨਿਤ ਸਾਚੁ ਤੀਰਥੁ ਮਜਨਾ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: gur vaak niramal sadaa chaanan nit saach teerath majanaa ||1||
lines.translation: The Guru's Word is immaculate and pure; it radiates a steady Light. Constantly bathe in such a true shrine of pilgrimage. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਚਿ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਮੈਲੁ ਕਿਆ ਮਲੁ ਧੋਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: saach na laagai mail kiaa mal dhoeeai ||
lines.translation: Filth does not stick to the true ones; what filth do they have to wash off?

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਣਹਿ ਹਾਰੁ ਪਰੋਇ ਕਿਸ ਕਉ ਰੋਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: gunahi haar paroi kis kau roeeai ||
lines.translation: If one strings a garland of virtues for oneself, what is there to cry for?

lines.gurmukhi: ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ਮਾਰੈ ਤਰੈ ਤਾਰੈ ਉਲਟਿ ਜੋਨਿ ਨ ਆਵਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: veechaar maarai tarai taarai ulat jon na aavae ||
lines.translation: One who conquers his own self through contemplation is saved, and saves others as well; he does not come to be born again.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਪਾਰਸੁ ਪਰਮ ਧਿਆਨੀ ਸਾਚੁ ਸਾਚੇ ਭਾਵਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: aap paaras param dhiaanee saach saache bhaavae ||
lines.translation: The supreme meditator is Himself the philosopher's stone, which transforms lead into gold. The true man is pleasing to the True Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਨੰਦੁ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਖੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਦੂਖ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਪਰਹਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: aana(n)d anadin harakh saachaa dookh kilavikh parahare ||
lines.translation: He is in ecstasy, truly happy, night and day; his sorrows and sins are taken away.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਗੁਰਿ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ਮੈਲੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਸਚ ਮਨੇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: sach naam paaiaa gur dikhaaiaa mail naahee sach mane ||2||
lines.translation: He finds the True Name, and beholds the Guru; with the True Name in his mind, no filth sticks to him. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਗਤਿ ਮੀਤ ਮਿਲਾਪੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਨਾਵਣੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)gat meet milaap pooraa naavano ||
lines.translation: O friend, association with the Holy is the perfect cleansing bath.
